CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS churn_notifications (
    user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    risk_level VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    days_since_login INTEGER NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (user_id)

-- Step 2: Insert at-risk users into the churn_notifications table
-- Calculate RRF (Retention Risk Factor) based on days since login and engagement rate
-- Classify risk levels: High (RRF > threshold), Medium, Low
INSERT INTO churn_notifications (user_id, risk_level, days_since_login, engagement_level)
SELECT 
    f.userregistry AS user_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN (d.days_since_login * 0.5 + (1 - e.engrate) * 50) > 60 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (d.days_since_login * 0.5 + (1 - e.engrate) * 50) > 40 THEN 'Medium'

    END AS risk_level,
    d.days_since_login,
    e.actfreq AS engagement_level
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON m.memberreg = p.preferencesmemberpivot
JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot

    SELECT ('2025-04-20'::date - p.lastlogdt) AS days_since_login
) d;
